note: One request mix for both gateways. Weights are relative. `expect` is the HTTP status both must answer; the check step refuses a mix where they differ. A request with weight 0 is in the check and never in the load.

requests.name: get_response
requests.excluded: abada does not implement response_body yet (docs/DESIGN.md): it answers the whole message where grpc-gateway answers `nested`. Not comparable, so not measured. `check` still prints it.
